entries.en: Used to think Brick was fuckin' psycho.
entries.ro: Credeam că Brick e nebun în pula mea.

entries.en: What, he isn't? Boys said he did some fucked-up shit before becomin' boss.
entries.ro: Ce, nu e? Băieții ziceau că a făcut niște rahaturi bolnave înainte să ajungă șef.

entries.en: I heard he broke into a 6th Street spot and started yelling, said whoever licks the NUSA's butthole is a fuckin' braindead gonk.
entries.ro: Am auzit că a spart într-un loc al 6th Street și a început să urle că oricine linge curul NUSA e un fraier nenorocit de tâmpit.

entries.en: Course, after the lead stopped flyin', they had to get him a new trachea. Crazy fuck said it was worth it.
entries.ro: Normal, după ce s-a oprit plumbul, i-au pus o trahee nouă. Nebunul dracului a zis că a meritat.

entries.en: Nah, don't mean that. Sure, Brick had a couple gonk ideas in that head, but mostly he was sharp enough.
entries.ro: N-asta vreau să zic. Da, Brick avea câteva idei de fraier în cap, dar în general era destul de deștept.

entries.en: Jumpin' Militech though – that's some next-level gonk shit.
entries.ro: Să ataci Militech – asta e rahat de fraier de nivel următor.
